description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance across three different LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct settings: no SFT, + SFT on $D_0$, + SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and + SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis displays the model names. Each model has four bars, corresponding to the four settings, with colors indicating the specific setting: light blue for "no SFT", tan for "+ SFT on $D_0$", light purple for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", and dark red for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". For all three models, performance generally increases with the addition of more SFT data, with the largest improvement seen for the LLaMA-2-70B model, which achieves the highest CoLeG-R score (approximately 83%) under the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" condition. The LLaMA-2-70B model consistently outperforms the smaller models across all settings, and the performance gap between the models widens as more SFT data is applied.
